document: conference paper (any field; follow the call for papers)
must_have: normalised comparison table (the conditions that drive each metric, the definition of the unit or operation, what each figure includes)

style.attribution: follow the venue: reference-as-subject ('[3] reported ...') in IEEE-style venues, author-year or concept-as-subject elsewhere; one convention throughout

pages: venue-specific; take the page limit, template and anonymisation rules from the call for papers
